faqs.title: 1. What is an Account Statement (AS)?
faqs.body: An Account Statement (AS) is a consolidated document that provides a detailed summary of all mutual fund transactions carried out by an investor. It includes information such as purchases, redemptions, switches, dividends, and the units allotted in the folio.

faqs.title: 2. When can I download the Account Statement?
faqs.body:
You can download the AS as soon as you begin investing with us.
An Account Statement is generated each time a transaction is processed and units are allotted in the investor’s folio.

faqs.title: 3. Is there a charge or fee for receiving the Account Statement?
faqs.body: No. There is no charge or fee for receiving or downloading your Account Statement.

faqs.title: 4. What types of statements can be downloaded through the AS feature?
faqs.body:
You can download the following types of statements:

PAN-based Account Statement: Consolidated view of all folios linked to the PAN.
Folio-based Account Statement: Statement specific to a single folio.
